intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A display stand is leaning to one side. Kaedra kneels and wedges a folded pamphlet under its short leg.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The pamphlet is *Siege Doctrine, Volume Two*. It is exactly the right thickness.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Someone suggested I smash it to save time.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “It would make a very satisfying noise. And a procurement request.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She presses on the stand. It holds. She presses again, for the record.

options.labelText: “Volume Two has finally found its calling.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “Volume One has been under my wardrobe for three years.”

options.labelText: “Go on, smash it. Show them what you can do.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “They know what I can do. That is why they keep suggesting it.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: A passing guard hears the word *smash* and edges toward a pillar.
